indicator_name: Livestock and poultry stock (cattle, sheep and goats, horses, camels, pigs, poultry) at end of month by region, thousand head
description: Поголовье скота и птицы (КРС, овцы и козы, лошади, верблюды, свиньи, птица) на конец месяца по регионам, тыс. голов
methodology: Taldau 701328, all farm categories, end of month: 2011-01…2019-12 under dimensions 67,488,2946 (cattle, sheep and goats, poultry only; horses, camels and pigs from 2020), 2020-01 on under 68,488,524,2946 (the later wins on a common date). National 2026-09: cattle 8 778.481, sheep and goats 22 609.56, horses 4 787.063, camels 311.565, pigs 534.794, poultry 49 247.093 thousand (= BNS file 8131).
